chunks.name: Clarity
chunks.text: {felt piano alone starts immediately on beat 1, clear repeating eighth-note motif, no fade in, no drums}

chunks.name: Unfold
chunks.text: {strings enter softly, a few glitchy clicks, tension builds quietly, still no kick, last beat almost silent}

chunks.name: Confident
chunks.text: {full beat, kick and sub bass hit together on beat 1, big confident entrance, driving groove}

chunks.name: Lift
chunks.text: {same groove, bigger, strings climb toward a final hit}

chunks.name: Button
styles: piano chord and strings ring out
chunks.text: {one big final hit on beat 1 with piano chord, strings and sub, then let it ring out, no more drums}
